_meta.purpose: Genuine romanisation variants of a dua's established popular name, for ADDENDUM §13. Read by scripts/build-dua-pages.mjs and rendered as ONE factual sentence in the lede plus schema.org alternateName.

rules.populateManually: Entries must be typed by hand from verified reference works. Never AI-generate a name, and never derive one from the chapter label.
rules.sameDuaOnly: alternateNames must be romanisation variants of the SAME dua (Ayat al-Kursi / Ayatul Kursi / Ayat ul Kursi). Never an unrelated keyword, English descriptor or invented title.
rules.mostHaveNone: Most of the 506 entries have no established popular name. An absent key is the correct and expected state, not a gap to fill.
rules.verifiedFlag: The builder ignores any entry whose `verified` is not true, so a draft can sit here safely without reaching a page.
rules.uniqueness: No alternate name may duplicate another dua's primaryName, and no alternate name may appear under more than one frozen slug.
